tours.title: Page tour: Finding your way around
tours.description: The menu, search, the Loop, Needs me and Ask the Hub: the parts that follow you everywhere.

tours.title: Page tour: Home
tours.description: Your personal queue: announcements to answer, meetings, tasks, mentions, updates and time, and your inbox when the assistant is on for you.

tours.title: Page tour: Your department page
tours.description: Your team's pulse, decisions, updates, meetings, projects and tools.

tours.title: Page tour: Team tasks and agendas
tours.description: Lists, boards and calendars for the team's work, and the team agenda.

tours.title: Page tour: Executive dashboard
tours.description: The numbers, what is new and the decisions that sit with the executives.

tours.title: Page tour: Delivery numbers
tours.description: How fast work moves: time to close, open workload and aging.

tours.title: Page tour: Goals (Strategy)
tours.description: The five organizational goals, edited live: this year's goals (FY27) with the current quarter, what is due next and what is overdue, the 8 charitable activities every goal is anchored on, each goal's owners, SMART statement, targets, paths, quarterly checkpoints and milestones by year, the projects that serve them, comments with @mentions, the history with Restore, the roadmap and the Strategy Library.

tours.title: Page tour: Projects
tours.description: Every active project by team, with its lead and its goal.

tours.title: Page tour: Goal alignment
tours.description: Every department's projects and the organizational goal each one serves, on one map.

tours.title: Page tour: Project pages
tours.description: One project's tasks, lead and progress: open any task to see and change it as on a team page (push it to the bank from there), tick it done with an Undo, link the team's existing tasks into the project, and how its lead can park the project in the bank.

tours.title: Page tour: Requests
tours.description: Ask another team for something, follow it through to done, and see what came in for your team, info@ emails included.

tours.title: Page tour: Transcript archive
tours.description: How a meeting becomes tasks, updates and decisions.

tours.title: Page tour: Agendas
tours.description: Build an agenda, run the meeting, share it.

tours.title: Page tour: Hub inbox
tours.description: What happens when you cc hub@welfareavenue.com, and how emails to info@ are passed on.

tours.title: Page tour: Org chart
tours.description: Who reports to whom, team by team, with the open positions. Executives and admins can rearrange it.

tours.title: Page tour: People pages
tours.description: A person's work, responsibilities, meetings and progress.

tours.title: Page tour: Avenue Academy
tours.description: Onboarding, what is assigned to you, Learning Avenues, tours, the library and your trophy case.

tours.title: Page tour: Volunteering
tours.description: The serving programme: calendar, events, checklist and roster, the format of each serving, and volunteers confirming their spot by text.

tours.title: Page tour: HR centre
tours.description: People, hours, onboarding and what new people see in the Academy, assigning trainings to the organization, hiring and policies.

tours.title: Page tour: Finance
tours.description: Finance, an app of its own apart from Fundraising: the ledger, budgets, nonprofit health, and Finance's own tasks and requests.

tours.title: Page tour: Content calendar
tours.description: Plan, approve and publish posts for six platforms, inside the Content Studio.

tours.title: Page tour: Marketing analytics
tours.description: Followers, reach and what worked over any range back to the start, every post with its numbers, who follows us, and how far back each platform goes.

tours.title: Page tour: Create studio
tours.description: Branded drafts from a short brief.

tours.title: Page tour: The Brain
tours.description: The living map of people, meetings, tasks and goals.

tours.title: Page tour: Important info
tours.description: Logins, shared drives and key links. Training videos live in the Avenue Academy.

tours.title: Page tour: Photo library
tours.description: Our photos, labelled and cleared for use, ready for posts, the Create studio, the fundraising events and the forms.

tours.title: Page tour: Activity
tours.description: The audit trail of every change.

tours.title: Page tour: Admin
tours.description: AI models, adoption, accounts, people and access (profiles and requests in one place), security and changes.

tours.title: Page tour: Calendar
tours.description: Fundraising events, board dates, your meetings, marketing posts, volunteering and birthdays in one calendar.

tours.title: Page tour: Events calendar
tours.description: The year's fundraising events with their photos and past fundraisers like them, the goals, and how to add and update them.

tours.title: Page tour: Board overview
tours.description: The three jobs of a board, the next meeting and its board pack, and each director's progress.

tours.title: Page tour: Committees
tours.description: How the four committees work, and how directors log their touchpoints.

tours.title: Page tour: The Task Bank
tours.description: Where work that can wait three months or more goes, how it comes back on its own, and how to bring it back early.

tours.title: Page tour: Our story
tours.description: The timeline since 2020, the milestones, where each moment came from, and the lessons learned.

tours.title: Page tour: Partners
tours.description: Every organization we have worked with or approached, whether it is a partner, a collaborator or a sponsor, and where each one stands. The page is in the CRM.

tours.title: Page tour: Document finder
tours.description: Find any file in our shared drives and Canva by what it is about.

tours.title: Page tour: CRM
tours.description: Everyone we know in one place: who they are to us, how to reach them, what they did with us, their email permission, and the duplicates to check.

tours.title: Page tour: the apps
tours.description: The 9 dots at the bottom of the menu: Strategy (the goals and projects), the CRM (with Partners), the HR centre, Finance and the Admin centre as apps of their own, each with its own menu, and the way back to the Hub.

tours.title: Page tour: The Loop
tours.description: I'm in, close the loop: what moved, where it goes, and what never goes in the post.

tours.title: Page tour: Fundraising app
tours.description: Events, donors, grants and the money they bring: the pipeline, Found for you, the funders, the grant writer, the playbook and the fact base, the calendar, the donor program and the event SOPs.

tours.title: Page tour: Sign-offs
tours.description: Volunteers' hours letters, letters of recognition and their own forms: check what they ask for, sign with your saved signature, or decline with a note.

tours.title: Page tour: Email studio
tours.description: Emails in the Welfare Avenue brand for one person, a list or an automation: three ways to start (tell the Hub, a template, build it yourself), the Hub's questions and checks, the editor, and sending or saving.

tours.title: Page tour: Strategy Library
tours.description: The documents that set Welfare Avenue's direction (our plans, the consulting work, the sources), what each one says and where it stands; pinned ones lead the Goals page.

tours.title: Walkthrough: HR centre, getting around
tours.description: The rail, Overview and its tiles, Needs HR, the bell and where every page lives. Hands-on.

tours.title: Walkthrough: recruitment, start to finish
tours.description: You are the applicant: add yourself with your own email and a CV link, take your card through Reviewing, a call, Interview, the offer letter (it arrives in your inbox) and Hired, then clear it. Hands-on, practice records only.

tours.title: Walkthrough: onboarding a new person
tours.description: Give yourself a practice onboarding plan, send the Welcome kit, open the checklist and HR setup, see the journey as a new person does, then remove it. Hands-on.

tours.title: Walkthrough: time off, both sides
tours.description: Ask for time off as a team member, approve it as HR, see what approving does (the calendar, the totals), log time off for someone. Hands-on, practice records only.

tours.title: Walkthrough: team, hours and recognition
tours.description: The roster, hours from The Loop and Slack against each minimum, what people shared, meeting attendance and shout-outs.

tours.title: Walkthrough: training and the onboarding plan
tours.description: Assign a training to yourself and stop it, follow who finished, and edit the master onboarding and preview what a new person sees. Hands-on.

tours.title: Walkthrough: policies and discipline
tours.description: Policies and sign-offs, adding and retiring a policy, how people sign, and the discipline tracker (look only).

tours.title: Page tour: Content Studio
tours.description: Plan, approve, post and answer comments on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube, with the queue, the library, short links and the monthly report.

tours.title: Page tour: Phone
tours.description: The Volunteer Manager's Phone page: texts and calls on the ops line in one place, what waits (texts nobody answered, missed calls nobody returned), one conversation with texts and calls, New text, Text a group, and how Call hands the number to the Quo app.

tours.title: Page tour: Volunteer calendar
tours.description: The Volunteer Manager has five places: Servings, Calendar, People (Volunteers, New applicants, Sign-offs), Messages (the ops line) and Setup (the SOP, recipes, inventory, spot counts, role owners, the text schedule). Where everyone is placed and Assign to servings.

tours.title: Page tour: Grants
tours.description: The Grants page: the grants tasks on their own page (out of the Fundraising page), who oversees them, Add a grants task, and the way into the Fundraising app's grants pipeline.

tours.title: Page tour: The texts volunteers get
tours.description: What goes out automatically for each serving (the confirmation 10 days before, the Monday reminder, the last day to cancel, the Thursday check-in, the itinerary, the survey), the Texts strip on a serving, the Text log, My roles, From the old sheet.
